correctness.rationale: For uniform size-m without-replacement rarefaction, I_i=1_{taxon i seen} gives absence q_i=C(N-a_i,m)/C(N,m) and joint absence q_ij=C(N-a_i-a_j,m)/C(N,m), so variance is Σq_i(1-q_i)+2Σ(q_ij−q_iq_j) exactly. Every possible positive abundance multiset N<=16 is one integer partition; every pair of taxa up to relabeling is one unordered value-pair. A standalone independent implementation using sympy integer partitions and Fraction was run, enumerating 3380 distinct merger types, verifying zero with >=3 strict adjacent flips for N<16 and exactly one at N=16. Its unique witness is eight singletons, 2,6 merged by (1,2), with 14 exact rational differences and flips m4→5,7→8,14→15 matching the source; 3380-row source CSV parsed and exact unique hit independently corroborated. The source verifier additionally constructs full richness generating distributions; source and certificate contents were inspected, not taken as proof by an exit-code alone. Complete finite enumeration is sufficient precisely because the theorem only asserts N<=16.
residual_risks: No assertion for N>16, nonuniform probabilities, empirical uncertainty or repeated mergers. Strict adjacent reversal excludes zeros; m=1 or N has zero richness variance.

value.rationale: Taxonomic pooling is a natural operation in community biodiversity measurement. Its expected richness decreases but the direction of sampling variance can reverse three times with sample depth; the exact minimal population size and unique witness classify the onset of this non-monotonic phenomenon. The 3380-case classification yields an independently useful exact fact for future analyses of taxonomic aggregation and uncertainty, not an arbitrary unmotivated finite slice.
residual_risks: Does not imply a general bound beyond N16 or real ecological sampling confidence-interval prescriptions.
